known_issues: Named APP-2 faculty, patient or caregiver, measurement, survey, health-services data, qualitative, equity, accessibility, language-access, privacy, responsible-AI, clinical, governance, model, and independent reproduction reviews remain pending before alpha.
The Module 06 partnership record is a labelled simulation and contains no actual patient or caregiver statement.
Public-derived linked and group evidence is descriptive; synthetic response and comment evidence cannot establish real experience, prevalence, equity, cause, feasibility, or benefit.
The 45-point score cannot compensate for a failed evidence, partnership, support, accessibility, protection, integrity, or progression gate.
No package authorizes patient contact, fielding, official HCAHPS reporting, patient targeting, group ranking, clinical action, implementation, or model deployment.
